data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 
 The Knowledge Society (TKS) is a global innovation program for ambitious teenagers focused on solving real\-world challenges. Over a 10\-month experience, TKS helps students become capable innovators and leaders by engaging with 40\+ emerging technologies and working on impactful projects with organizations like Microsoft, Interac, and the United Nations. The program emphasizes experimentation, building, and creating meaningful solutions rather than memorization, and is designed by leaders from McKinsey, Google, and Stanford to mirror the culture of top startups like SpaceX and DeepMind. Since 2016, TKS has supported more than 4,000 students across 60\+ countries through in\-person and global virtual programs, cultivating a diverse community centered on leadership, growth, and innovation. The organization is rapidly growing and expanding its reach, offering team members the chance to shape the future of youth innovation at scale.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Associate Director role at TKS is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Dubai, UAE. This role is responsible for supporting the Dubai Program Director in delivering the 10\-month TKS program to \~160 students. Our directors have a passion for unlocking potential, want to help make a difference in the world, and have unique backgrounds/experiences.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* **Program Facilitation:** 
 Collaborate with the Program Director to facilitate the program and deliver engaging weekly sessions to students.
* **Experiential Opportunities:** 
 Design and execute unique, hands\-on learning experiences such as attending conferences, hosting guest speakers, and organizing tours of companies or labs, as feasible.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Serve as a primary point of contact for parents, mentors, and partners, ensuring timely and clear communication to align on program goals and student success.
* **Student Mentorship:** 
 Provide personalized mentorship, guidance, and constructive feedback to accelerate student growth in both project work and personal development.
* **Logistical Support:** 
 Assist the Program Director in managing logistics for unique student experiences, such as conferences, events, guest speaker sessions, and industry or lab tours.
* **Student Recruitment:** 
 Actively recruit driven and high\-potential students by building relationships with schools, leveraging community networks, hosting information sessions, and developing strategic partnerships, alongside reviewing applications and conducting interviews to select the best candidates for the program.



  





**Qualifications:** 




  




* **Experience:** 
 2\-5 years of professional work experience, preferably in education, technology, or program management.
* **Program Expertise:** 
 Experience in implementing and leading engaging programs or initiatives.



  





**Traits:** 




  




* **Passion for Education and Technology:** 
 A deep interest in education, emerging technologies, and cultivating the next generation of leaders and innovators.
* **Communication:** 
 Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and connect with diverse groups of students, stakeholders, and partners.
* **Adaptability:** 
 Ability to adapt, figure things out, and thrive in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.

data.jd_text:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Project Director**
**The Company**
 WPP Production is a fast growing division of WPP group. WPP Production is headquartered in London but is present in many markets around the world, working through three global hubs (Singapore, New York and London) and with customer service and production facilities in multiple countries across every continent.
   

  

 WPP Production is an expert provider of marketing communications and advertising production services across Broadcast, Print and Digital media with a full suite of services that can take a creative advertising or promotional concept and deliver it, translated and culturally adapted, in whatever the required medium into every target market in the world, with better turnaround times, higher quality, more functional technology and more effective return on production investment than any competitive offering.
   

  

 Our clients are the world’s leading brands in consumer goods, financial services, automotive and electronics and we therefore compete in markets that demand the absolute highest standards of quality, customer care, reliability and value.
   

  

 Culturally, we seek to combine the entrepreneurial enthusiasm and creativity of an agency start up with the standards and delivery of a world\-class professional services business.
   

  

 We are a culturally diverse organization in a period of transition. We currently have around 2,300 full time employees representing the results of 8 years of continuous growth since start up.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for a passionate leader and technical champion for the creation of rich front\-end experiences.
   

  

 You will manage a team of HTML5, Javascript, CSS developers and be ultimately responsible for the clients’ technical delivery.
   

  

 You have an in\-depth knowledge of current and emerging front\-end technologies and can work with server\-side technical leads to create and integrate complex client\-side applications. You will have a clear idea of what ‘good’ looks like, and be able to communicate best practice to your colleagues and fellow project members. You will work with WPP Production and partner organisations to define the optimum technical approach for client projects and ceaselessly promote best practice, quality and craft in your code and the code of those you lead.
   

  

 Strong communication skills, including the ability to listen, understand, advocate, and persuade are essential as you will represent your practice in client and internal senior stakeholder meetings.
   

  

 You will Provide technical thought leadership and promote the vision, strategy and services of the digital department to both educate our teams within Hogarth and to be seen as a leading figure in the industry.
   

  

 Define our distributed development strategy and processes across our onshore, offshore and remote teams, including identifying and developing key strategic technology partnerships.
   

  

 You will manage a team of highly skilled developers ranging from Graduate to Senior level, implementing and maintaining development practices, running meetings and workshops that ensure the growth, motivation and continued development of the team, and ultimately take responsibility for the quality of your team’s output.
   

  

 The team needs to build/modify responsive web pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, etc. based on the visual briefs.
   

  

 You will work closely with other discipline leads (QA/PM) to ensure scoping, estimates, and requirements are estimated correctly and delivered with minimal errors.
   

  

 You must be enthusiastic about technology and constantly be looking at the next innovation. On top of possessing strong oral, interpersonal, and organizational abilities, you must be able to work in a fast paced environment. Flexibility and tolerance is a necessity.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Co\-ordinating with leads across key delivery teams (Tech, Project Management, QA, and Resource Management)
* Ensure compliance with WPP production processes
* Acting as the point of escalation for project issues raised by team leads, resolving problems quickly and communicating effectively
* Coaching and developing the team in their roles with regular performance reviews to ensure success in their personal development
* Manage the team hiring and keeping briefs clear and consistently updated
* Interviewing candidates for the team and taking responsibility for the approval of freelancers to work in a fast paced and reactive environment
* Set and manage client expectations while coordinating and ensuring all parties follow the agreed workflows
* Build strong, trusting relationships with all key stakeholders, function leads, cross\-functional project managers, senior managers, and third\-party vendors that are directly involved with the work
* Manage the approval of quarterly budgets, flagging important budget fluctuations to the client and line manager
* Draft, prepare and present timelines, documents, and presentations and reports both to the client and to the team
* Ensure that the line manager is always aware of all client issues and proposed solutions (including potential delays) to ensure swift resolution and avoid further escalation
* Ensure your account consistently delivers against all contractual obligations including SLAs and KPIs
* Act as a brand QC/Guardian – always ensure brand guidelines, QC checklists and procedures are followed
* Keep GAD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
* teamwork, create balanced work schedule and ensure people are able to deliver results
* Identify training requirements for team members to ensure their adherence to processes and workflow
* Plan resources for overseas projects and inform talent manager and line manager of new recruitment needs
* Plan, prepare and implement the induction of new starters


**Requirements**
* A minimum of 10 years Project Management experience background
* Experience of leading innovation, leveraging emerging platforms and quickly facilitating new ideas and platforms to market
* Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills
* Know\-how in working cross\-functionally to build relationships between business units, technology, product, media, agency, and design teams
* Experience working on international initiatives \- ideally with exposure to emerging markets
* Self\-motivated and a self\-starter
* Very high competence in project management software such as Microsoft Project and Omniplan
* Extensive experience in costing, quotations and project scope definition


* Excellent communication skills to different target groups within the project team, management and clients
* Ensure understanding of the contractual obligations, commercial arrangements and SLAs of the accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the wider team where relevant
* Analytical and detailed in project documentation, accountability, and tracking
* Pragmatic, team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Understanding of brands and brand challenges
* The ability to function productively in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment
* High level of IT literacy, including use of spreadsheets
* Strong numeracy skills
* Support GAD/CSD and FD in revenue forecasting on an ongoing basis
* Keep GAD/CSD and FD informed of any circumstances which would positively or negatively affect forecasts
* Ensure full compliance with all financial procedure and policies
* Prioritization, time management and attention to detail
* Resilience and ability to work under pressure
* Excellent communication skills, written and verbal, in both Arabic and English
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Highly organised, detail oriented, customer focused, and proactive
* Possess technical understanding of mobile and web technologies necessary to run projects and convey details. Examples would be:
+ iOS and Android development
+ Cloud computing
+ HTML5/CSS/JavaScript
+ ecommerce/Shopping Carts
+ Social Media Strategies/Platforms

* Familiarity with creative production and development tools is always an advantage. Such software includes Adobe Creative Suite, BBEdit, SVN, GitHub, Eclipse, Dreamweaver, Final Cut Pro and others. In addition, familiarity with mobile and web platforms and ecosystems would also be advantageous
* Must be able to travel as required, sometimes for several weeks at a time


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Office Director to oversee and coordinate all aspects of the Office’s activities. This leadership role will focus on managing strategic partnerships, insights, and convenings while effectively managing a team. The Office Director will play a key role in strengthening communication and coordination among government and business leaders locally and internationally.
 



  





 The Office Director will ensure that strategic objectives are met by driving engagements, developing relationships, leading high\-level meetings, and fostering cross\-sectoral collaborations. This individual should possess deep expertise in managing partnerships, delivering insights, organizing convenings, and guiding team members to advance key initiatives.
 



  





**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Partnerships Leadership:** 



* Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders in government and business sectors locally and in priority global regions.
* Oversee the identification, engagement, and management of partnerships with multilateral organizations, international forums, and influential family and corporate entities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for partners, facilitating productive interactions and ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Collaborate with Embassies, diplomats, and government ministries to align partnership initiatives with Office goals and diplomatic missions.
* Drive the creation and management of a partnership database and maintain records of strategic engagements.



  





**2\. Insights Generation and Dissemination:** 



* Lead the design and execution of research projects, including studies, surveys, and workshops that inform strategy.
* Facilitate and manage regular insights sessions for senior businesses and governmental stakeholders on emerging geo\-economic and strategic issues.
* Oversee the development of high\-quality reports, briefings, and presentations that synthesize research findings into actionable insights.
* Guide content development in collaboration with team members to ensure alignment with Office objectives.
* Coordinate closely with the Communications Manager to ensure effective dissemination of insights through appropriate channels.



  





**3\. Convenings Management:** 



* Oversee the planning and execution of high\-level convenings, such as roundtables, conferences, and multi\-stakeholder meetings locally and key international locations.
* Ensure seamless coordination of event logistics, including venue selection, participant engagement, and on\-site management.
* Work collaboratively with team members to develop event agendas, speaker briefings, and session formats that align with strategic themes.
* Maintain a comprehensive annual convening strategy and identify opportunities to enhance or expand convening activities.
* Direct the collection and analysis of event feedback and post\-event reporting to guide continuous improvements.



  





**4\. Communication and Coordination with the Communications Manager:** 



* Establish and maintain open channels of communication with the Communications Manager to align messaging strategies with key objectives.
* Coordinate on the development of high\-quality content for various platforms, ensuring consistency and alignment with strategic themes.
* Work collaboratively on media relations, press releases, and social media campaigns to enhance visibility.
* Guide the Communications Manager in crafting strategic communication plans for key events and projects.



  





**5\. Coordination with the Office Manager:** 



* Regularly engage with the Office Manager to oversee day\-to\-day administrative activities and ensure smooth operations.
* Collaborate on project timelines, office logistics, and team schedules to ensure alignment with priorities.
* Review and approve budget tracking, expense reports, and procurement activities managed by the Office Manager.
* Ensure that HR processes, onboarding, and team member support initiatives are aligned with the Office's overall strategy.



  





**6\. Reporting and Accountability Activities:** 



* Lead the development of comprehensive reports and updates, summarizing the progress of strategic projects and partnerships.
* Implement standardized reporting practices for all functions within the Office to maintain accountability and transparency.
* Oversee the preparation of policy briefings and reports for key stakeholders.
* Ensure timely submission of reports to senior leadership, facilitating informed decision\-making and strategic planning.



  





**7\. Supervisory Responsibilities:** 



* Mentor and provide performance oversight for the Office Staff team members.
* Foster a collaborative environment that encourages proactive problem\-solving and innovation.
* Oversee team collaboration and ensure team members have the resources and guidance needed to achieve key objectives.



  





**Essential Professional Experience / Skills** 




 This role requires a dynamic, strategic thinker with exceptional interpersonal skills and a deep understanding of the interplay between government and business. The ideal candidate will be adept at navigating complex stakeholder landscapes and passionate about fostering collaborations that advance the Office's interests on the global stage.
 


* Minimum of 10 years of experience in senior management roles involving partnerships, strategic insights, and event convenings, ideally in government or diplomatic settings.
* Proven track record of developing and sustaining high\-level partnerships across business and governmental sectors.
* Strong understanding of the global landscape of business and diplomacy, with experience in strategic research and insights generation.
* Exceptional communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills with a diplomatic approach.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to oversee multiple large\-scale projects simultaneously.
* Fluency in English; Arabic language skills are highly desirable.
* Experience in leading and managing diverse, multicultural teams.

data.jd_text:
The Center for Arab Studies and Islamic Civilizations (CASIC) at the American University of Sharjah (AUS) in the United Arab Emirates invites applications for the full\-time CASIC Faculty Director position. The successful candidate will have a specialization in a relevant field of Arabic studies, Islamic civilization, or a closely related discipline, broadly defined.
   

  

 The successful candidate will also serve as Co\-Chair of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) Chair in Arabic Language, AI, and Digital Heritage. The UNESCO Chair promotes interdisciplinary research, education, and international collaboration at the intersection of Arabic language studies, artificial intelligence, and digital heritage preservation. In this role, the candidate will provide academic leadership and build partnerships that advance the Chair’s research, education, and outreach and strengthen its regional and global impact.
   

  

 CASIC draws on AUS’s expertise across academic disciplines to promote innovative, multidisciplinary research on the cultural continuity and diversity of the Arab and Islamic worlds. CASIC aligns its research objectives with key priorities in Sharjah and the UAE, emphasizing the study of the Arabic language, heritage, history, and cultures of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Situated at the heart of the Arab and Islamic worlds and shaped by cultural influences from both East and West, CASIC offers a counterpoint to Western approaches to the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization.
   

  

 CASIC conducts in\-depth research on the region’s history, cultures, arts, contemporary dynamics, and diasporas. Its work will focus on cultural heritage, arts, and architecture; language, literature, and media studies; humanities, performing arts, and visual communication; economy, society, and the digital age. The center seeks to reorient the study of the Arab world and Islamic civilization both regionally and globally. CASIC seeks a director with deep knowledge of the culture, history, and contemporary realities of the Arab and Islamic worlds. Proficiency in Islamicate languages is desirable. The director will shape the center’s long\-term strategy, set clear priorities, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. The center will build research programs that combine the scholarly traditions of Arab and Islamic civilizations with contemporary methods, applying them to the needs of modern UAE society, the Arab region, and the wider world.
   

  

 AUS offers several educational programs that align with and support CASIC's activities and goals. These programs provide strength in Arabic and Translation Studies; the History and Culture of the Arab World; Islamic Arts and Architecture; Philosophy; Middle Eastern Studies; the Politics and Economy of the Arab World; and Arab Media, Visual Communication, and Performing Arts. CASIC will serve as a central hub, uniting expertise from within AUS and engaging with local and international stakeholders to address cultural and societal issues. The center aims to foster partnerships highlighting Arab and Islamic contributions to global heritage. The center will collaborate closely with organizations such as the Sharjah Art Foundation, the Sharjah Museums Authority, the Sharjah Arabic Language Academy, and others.
   

  

 CASIC’s leadership will build the center into a globally recognized hub for the study of Arab and Islamic civilizations and strengthen AUS’s research profile. The center will prioritize disseminating knowledge, building strategic partnerships with local and international institutions and researchers, and fostering academic collaboration. Furthermore, CASIC will invest in talent development by supporting graduate student research, postdoctoral fellowships, and visiting scholars.
   

  

 Faculty Director candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant field at the time of appointment, demonstrate an excellent record of academic and research leadership, and, ideally, be prepared to relocate to the UAE by
 **December 2026\.**
 As an institution based on the American model of higher education and with English as the medium of instruction, AUS prioritizes candidates with significant experience in similar educational systems.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Please fill the application Form
   

  

 The complete application will include the following documents, uploaded as separate files: a letter of application, a curriculum vitae, a list of three referees with contact information, a research statement, a teaching statement, a chapter\- or article\-length publication sample, and evidence of prior research leadership experience.
   

  

 Situated near Sharjah International Airport in the expansive University City area and only 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport, AUS is in a dynamic, cosmopolitan area with abundant opportunities for travel, entertainment, cultural experiences, and natural beauty. Salary and benefits are competitive.
   

  

 The American University of Sharjah is a not\-for\-profit, independent, coeducational institution of higher education formed on American models but thoroughly grounded in Arab culture. Located in University City, Sharjah, AUS offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs to more than 5,800 students from approximately 90 nations. English is the language of instruction and the workplace. AUS has been ranked among the top 10 Arab universities by the QS World University Rankings for the past 9 consecutive years.
   

  

 AUS is licensed, and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\.

**Job Purpose**

The role is accountable for maximizing business value through technology innovation, standardization, automation, and scalable digital solutions.
   

  

* Develop and maintain the P\&T strategy for operational systems and software platforms.
* Define the long\-term vision, target architecture, and digital transformation roadmap for operational technologies.
* Align technology initiatives with corporate strategy, operational objectives, customer requirements, and industry trends.

* Define system ownership models, decision\-making processes, and performance measurement frameworks.

Assist the Business Units in selecting and implementing the right systems and related periphery technologies.

* Deliver solutions to DP World Group challenges in all disciplines.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Develop and maintain multi\-year operational systems roadmaps aligned with strategic business priorities, capability gaps, modernization opportunities, and future technology requirements.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and return on investment, while monitoring technology trends and recommending strategic investments.
* Define and oversee implementation strategies for new systems, upgrades, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring successful program execution and a smooth transition into operational support and continuous improvement.

* Lead evaluation, selection, and management of software vendors and technology partners for Ports \& Terminals, including negotiation of strategic agreements, monitoring of performance and innovation roadmaps, and management of contractual obligations.
* Govern the commercial and contractual relationship between business units and internal/external system providers.
* Ensure operational systems comply with cybersecurity, regulatory, privacy, and industry standards, and identify, assess, and mitigate technology\-related operational risks.
* Establish business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for critical operational systems.
* Standardize processes and align key performance indicators to reduce customization across system implementations and improve consistency across disciplines.
* Support comparison, selection, and implementation of operational systems and technologies across the Ports \& Terminals portfolio.
* Assess TOS utilization effectiveness across business units and strengthen adoption through training recommendations in collaboration with DP World Hub and relevant learning tools.
* Direct the development roadmap of the internal TOS, Zodiac, in alignment with the global TOS strategy.
* Manage TOS and peripheral technology vendor relationships from a central head office perspective, including regular user groups to build alignment, knowledge sharing, and operational adoption.
* Advise senior management on AFE for P\&T Systems.
* Act as liaison and quality control point for collecting business requirements for operational system implementations and system enhancements.
* Maintain relationships with all third\-party service providers and vendors supporting operational systems and technology.
* Direct and improve the Group’s Innovation portfolio, strengthening innovation maturity across all pillars, including Ports \& Terminals, Logistics, Digital Solutions, and Marine.
* Champion an innovation culture across DP World by encouraging idea generation, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and adoption of new solutions across all pillars.
* Measure the impact of innovation outcomes on DP World’s business, including value creation, cost savings, customer satisfaction, and human safety and wellbeing.
* Direct the groupwide Innovation Platform (INNOGATE) development roadmap and ensure innovative projects and solutions are integrated into commercial, marketing, supply chain, and operational processes.
* Manage geographically dispersed and functionally diverse internal and external teams to maintain a single view of the innovation portfolio and ensure effective delivery.
* Stay abreast of industry and technology trends and market developments, and make recommendations to DP World accordingly.


**Education**
 Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

 Experience in managing the terminal business.

 DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.
   

  

 We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

**About:** 




 Alef Group is a pioneer in developing premier lifestyle communities, destinations, and experiences through investment and strategic joint ventures, seeking a highly skilled and experienced Manager \- Retail Delivery with specific Retail Delivery management experience to join our team in Sharjah.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Manager – Retail Delivery is responsible for managing the end\-to\-end delivery and operational readiness of retail assets, ensuring seamless transition from project completion to business operations. The role ensures retail spaces are delivered in line with approved designs, quality standards, statutory requirements, and tenant expectations. The position acts as the key link between development, construction, leasing, operations, and facilities management teams to achieve timely handover, minimize delivery risks, and enable successful retail activation.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Retail Asset Delivery \& Handover Management** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end retail delivery and handover process from project completion through operational readiness, ensuring assets are delivered on time, compliant, and ready for activation.
* Coordinate with project teams, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to monitor retail asset progress and achieve successful handover milestones.
* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and de\-snagging activities to ensure retail units and common areas are delivered defect\-free and operationally ready.
* Review project completion status, technical submissions, and handover documentation to ensure all retail assets meet approved requirements before acceptance.
* Drive final inspections, authority approvals, and completion certification processes to achieve timely retail opening readiness.



**Retail Quality, Design \& Compliance Management** 



* Ensure delivered retail spaces comply with approved design standards, brand guidelines, technical specifications, and quality expectations to protect asset value and customer experience.
* Monitor construction quality and delivery standards through regular inspections and audits to identify risks and ensure timely resolution of issues.
* Verify compliance with UAE regulations, authority requirements, health and safety standards, and environmental guidelines to achieve regulatory acceptance.
* Manage the completion and accuracy of retail handover documentation, including as\-built drawings, O\&M manuals, warranties, asset registers, and operational records.



**Tenant Delivery \& Operational Readiness** 



* Coordinate with Leasing, Retail Operations, and Facilities Management teams to ensure retail units are prepared for tenant fit\-out, opening, and business operations.
* Facilitate tenant handover activities by ensuring spaces, services, and supporting infrastructure are ready in accordance with agreed delivery requirements.
* Support tenant\-related technical coordination and resolve delivery issues to enhance tenant satisfaction and minimize delays to store opening.
* Establish processes for defect liability period (DLP) management to ensure timely closure of post\-handover issues and maintain service standards.



**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management** 



* Collaborate with Development, Engineering, Design, Construction, Leasing, Finance, and Legal teams to align retail delivery activities with business objectives.
* Act as the primary coordination point between project delivery teams and operational stakeholders to ensure smooth transition from development to operations.
* Resolve delivery challenges and escalate critical risks to management to support timely decision\-making and project completion.
* Coordinate commercial and contractual close\-out activities with relevant teams to ensure completion of outstanding obligations.



**Retail Delivery Performance \& Governance** 



* Develop retail delivery KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track progress, risks, quality, and readiness status.
* Monitor delivery performance against approved timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks to ensure achievement of business targets.
* Prepare regular management reports highlighting delivery status, key risks, mitigation actions, and handover readiness.
* Implement governance processes and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance retail delivery efficiency and stakeholder experience.



**Team Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Lead and manage retail delivery team members, coordinators, and specialists to achieve project handover objectives effectively.
* Develop team capabilities in retail delivery processes, quality management, stakeholder coordination, and operational readiness.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus to improve delivery outcomes and team performance.



  





**Educational Qualifications, Work Experience, and Skills Required:** 




  





**Educational Qualification \& Certifications:** 



* Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Real Estate Development, or related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, RICS, LEED, or equivalent are preferred.



  





**Work Experience:** 



* Must have a minimum of 5 years in Retail Delivery management experience with a prominent retail developer in the UAE.
* Must have a proven experience of managing large\-scale retail, commercial, or mixed\-use asset handovers from construction completion to operational readiness.
* Strong understanding of retail development lifecycle, tenant handover requirements, fit\-out coordination, and UAE/GCC construction regulations.



  





**Skills required:** 



* Strong knowledge of retail asset delivery, construction processes, commissioning, and handover management.
* Strong project management and stakeholder coordination capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong understanding of quality assurance, compliance, and operational readiness requirements.
* Customer and tenant\-focused mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency in ERP systems, CAFM platforms, project management tools, and handover management systems.

data.jd_text:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



  





 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Technology department would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Head of Engineering Excellence** 
 in our office in Dubai.
 



  





 As the Head of Engineering Excellence, you will…
 



 Be the force that turns Equiti’s engineering principles into everyday practice. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own the operating system of the technology organisation — the standards, processes, delivery cadence and metrics that keep a fast\-scaling, multi\-domain engineering org accountable, aligned and continuously improving. You will be the CTO’s trusted partner for execution: making sure the right things get done, by the right owners, to the right standard — without the CTO having to chase.
 



 You will define and enforce how the engineering org works — ways of working, communication and accountability standards, and delivery governance — and make performance visible through engineering KPIs and dashboards. You will lead a culture of Kaizen (continuous improvement), running the cadences and retrospectives that turn data and incidents into lasting improvements across mobile, web, backend, data, platform, QA and trading teams.
 



 You will also be Equiti’s engineering voice to the outside world — championing our work through blogs, talks and conferences, growing our presence in the developer community, and building the technical brand that draws great people to us.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own and enforce Equiti’s engineering principles, standards and ways of working across all technology domains.
* Define, track and report engineering KPIs — delivery throughput and predictability, DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change\-failure rate, MTTR), responsiveness/SLA attainment and quality — and turn them into action.
* Run the engineering operating cadence: planning, delivery reviews, incident/postmortem reviews and the operations review that holds owners accountable to SLAs.
* Drive a culture of Kaizen / continuous improvement — facilitate retrospectives, identify systemic bottlenecks, and land process improvements that stick.
* Embed the communication \& accountability framework — ownership/RACI, triage lanes, escalation and channel standards — so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Govern cross\-team delivery for major programmes and product launches; surface risks and dependencies early and unblock them.
* Partner with domain leads to raise engineering maturity, consistency and governance — without slowing teams down.
* Act as the CTO’s go to on execution — translate strategy into tracked outcomes, prepare leadership and board\-ready updates, and ensure follow\-through on decisions.
* Champion engineering quality, change management and operational excellence in partnership with SRE / Engineering Platforms.
* Establish lightweight tooling and dashboards (within the ticketing and observability stack) that make standards and metrics self\-serve for every team.
* Lead Equiti’s external engineering evangelism — represent the technology org through conference talks, meetups and panels, and grow our standing in the wider engineering community.
* Own the Equiti engineering blog and technical thought leadership, and shape the engineering employer brand that helps attract and retain top talent.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years in software engineering, technical programme management, or engineering operations, with at least 5 years leading process or delivery excellence in scaled engineering organisations.
* Proven track record defining and enforcing engineering principles, ways of working and delivery governance across multiple teams.
* Deep fluency in engineering KPIs and metrics (DORA, delivery predictability, quality, reliability) and in building dashboards that change behaviour.
* Hands\-on experience leading continuous improvement / Kaizen, Agile, and incident/postmortem practices at scale.
* Strong technical credibility — able to hold weight with senior engineers and architects — without needing to be the deepest coder in the room.
* Exceptional influence and stakeholder management; able to enforce standards through trust and clarity, not authority alone.
* A confident public communicator — a track record of external technical writing, conference speaking, or developer\-community engagement (engineering blogs, talks, open source).
* Experience operating as a trusted partner to a CTO or VP of Engineering (programme leadership / execution\-focused role) strongly preferred.
* Experience in fintech, brokerage, or regulated industries preferred.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Dubai.



  





  





**Perks** 




  





 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



  





 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



  





 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
The Senior Manager of Governance is responsible for developing the information security and cybersecurity strategy and plan. This role aims to protect DET’s Information assets from risks, threats, and attacks by establishing robust security policies and aligning them with local and federal mandates, such as those from the Dubai Cyber Security Strategy and the Dubai Electronic Security Center.
 



  





 The responsibilities include managing policy implementation, managing risk assessments, delivering training programs, and ensuring compliance across all technology platforms. Conducting investigations on information security policy breaches and recommending solutions. Coordinating with regulatory bodies and stakeholders to maintain and report on DET’s security posture, ensuring a secure operational environment.
 



  





**Core Functional Responsibilities** 



* Develop the DET Group’s information security and cybersecurity strategy and plan in order to mitigate risks, attacks, and threats on the data assets of the DET Group.
* Design and manage new programs, projects, initiatives, and enhancement and implementation roadmap to strengthen the DET security.
* Manage the Information Security governance process including Policy and Standards across the DET.
* Ensure the alignment of the DET Group’s information security and cybersecurity strategy with local and federal strategies, such as the Dubai Cyber Security Strategy, and other requirements set by DESC. Additionally, maintain compliance with the ISO 27001:2022 standard to uphold international best practices in information security management alongside the ISR.
* Develop and implement of information security and cybersecurity policies, procedures, and standards for the DET Group, ensuring alignment with the ISR as well as leading practices and trends.
* Manage the provision of awareness and training sessions and program to all employees, leaders, strategic partners, etc. on information security and cyber security policies, to mitigate potential policy breaches.
* Conduct thorough and ongoing audits to ensure all employees, leaders, and strategic partners strictly adhere to DET's information security and cybersecurity policies. This includes verifying system access compliance, facilitating cybersecurity training, assessing risks, and maintaining detailed audit trails for continuous improvement and accountability.
* Provide support as needed, to manage any exceptions or deviations from information security and cybersecurity policies.
* Manage the implementation of information and cybersecurity risk assessments on DET Group, in order to gain intelligence on information security and cyber threats and risks DET is vulnerable to, based on its operations and its IT infrastructure components including applications, cloud, cryptography, and infrastructure, and accordingly recommend risk mitigation measures.
* Manage investigations on information security policy breaches conducted internally or through external parties, ensure policy breaches are being accurately reported, and accordingly identify solutions to policy breaches.
* Develop reports pertaining to information security and cybersecurity risk assessments results, as well as incidents related to information security.
* Ensure reports are being circulated to relevant stakeholders, and manage the delivery of presentations to the Director General as well as the Information Security Committee, as needed.
* Provide guidance and advice to end users, when needed, regarding potential threats and key considerations for the safe usage of systems and exchange of information.
* Provide guidance and subject matter expertise when it comes to the enhancement of information security controls, in coordination with the Technology team as well as IT vendors.

data.jd_text:
**Locations** 
 : Dubai \| Riyadh
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 The Middle East IT Service Manager is the face of Tech@BCG in a key market for BCG. Spanning Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Abu Dhabi, and Kuwait, this role is not a back\-office function: it is the primary connection between a demanding regional business and the global IT organisation. Local business leadership knows this person by name, calls them first, and relies on them to make technology work.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of the local business and the IT function. It owns regional IT service delivery end to end, manages senior stakeholder relationships, feeds office demand and business feedback into the IT organisation, and ensures that what is built and delivered globally actually works for the Middle East. The person in this role represents the business to IT, and IT to the business.
   

  

 In practice, this means running a tight operation, governing vendors and contracts with discipline, driving a sustained shift towards automation and AI\-enabled support, and always knowing what the numbers are telling you. It requires someone equally comfortable in a service review and a conversation with a Managing Director, who understands that trust with the business is the foundation everything else is built on.
   

  

 Beyond operations, this role demands a genuine people leader. Someone who invests in their team, listens before they act, and creates an environment where people do their best work. Within the broader EMESA IT Service community, this person is a collaborative and engaged peer: sharing what works, supporting colleagues across other regions, and contributing to a function that is stronger because its leaders work well together. If you lead with integrity, bring others with you, and take the success of the team as seriously as your own, this role is for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Stakeholder Relationships \& Business Partnering
* Serve as the primary point of contact for local business leadership across all Middle East offices as the face of Tech@BCG in the region
* Actively manage senior stakeholder relationships, building trust with office leadership and ensuring IT is seen as a partner, not a utility
* Capture, consolidate, and feed local business demand and feedback into the global IT organisation and translating office needs into inputs the IT function can act on
* Own the senior escalation path for critical incidents and high\-impact service events, and maintain playbooks for executive support and key office moments
* Capacity \& Financial Management
* Ensure regional capacity is managed in line with global and functional targets, escalating deviations and translating business demand into resourcing inputs for the IT organisation
* Build cost\-to\-serve visibility at office level to support data\-led conversations with both local leadership and global IT
* Challenge and reduce local service deviations where demand doesn’t justify them
* Drive the shift from human\-touch support to automation and self\-service. This is a direction of travel, not a one\-off project
* Automation \& AI\-Enabled Support
* Set and own targets for no\-contact and low\-contact resolution rates across the region

 Vision \& Strategy:
   

  

* Define and execute the regional strategy for mission\-critical data centres, aligning with WSP’s global vision and Middle East priorities.

 Business Development:
   

  

* Lead strategic initiatives to expand WSP’s footprint in the Middle East data centre market, securing new opportunities and partnerships.


 Quality, Safety \& Operations (QSO):

 Leadership \& Team Management

data.jd_text:
**Director Advisory Group Water \& Maritime Middle East** 




 Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
 



  





**What you do as a Director Advisory Group** 




 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
 



  





 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
 



  





 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
 



  





 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
 



 Key Performance Indicators:
 


* **P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement** 
 : Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.



  




* **Stakeholder management:** 
 Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.



  




* **People management** 
 : Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.



  




* **Project Delivery** 
 (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:



 \-Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
 



 \-Driving Financial performance
 



 \-Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.
 



  





 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
 



  





**Where will you work** 




 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
 



 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
 



  





**What you bring** 




 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
 



  




* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders



  





**What we offer** 




 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
 


* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance



  





**Are you our new colleague?** 




 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
 



 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
 



 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
 



  





 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
 



***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex port and marine infrastructure projects in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, analytical thinking, and a comprehensive understanding of ports and marine operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 8\+ years of project management experience, with at least 5 years in ports, marine, or maritime infrastructure projects

* Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and manage complex stakeholder relationships



 \*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*
   

  




* Experience managing projects in the Middle East region
* Familiarity with marine terminal operations and cargo handling systems
* Experience with design\-build or engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) project delivery models
* Advanced certifications in risk management or specialized maritime project management


**Additional Information**

 Degree in Civil engineering

data.title: Construction Manager
data.raw_snippet: The Construction Manager – Electrical is responsible for the comprehensive planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large\-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects, particularly in the power and infrastructure sectors. The role requires a highly experienced professional
data.jd_text:
The Construction Manager – Electrical is responsible for the comprehensive planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large\-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects, particularly in the power and infrastructure sectors. The role requires a highly experienced professional with a Degree Electrical Engineering and 8 to 15 years of proven experience in executing electrical projects across Gulf countries and/or India. The candidate must possess strong technical knowledge and leadership skills to handle complex project environments, including substations, power plants, and overhead transmission line projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in the construction of medium and large substations, including associated civil and electrical works. Demonstrated expertise in handling power projects such as high\-voltage substations, transmission networks, and overhead lines is essential. The Construction Manager will be accountable for overseeing all construction activities, ensuring adherence to project specifications, design drawings, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 A key responsibility of this role is to ensure the smooth execution of the entire project lifecycle, from mobilization to commissioning and final handover. The candidate must possess strong project management skills to coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and vendors. The role demands excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to manage stakeholder expectations and resolve project\-related challenges efficiently.
   

  

 The Construction Manager must take full ownership of project timelines, ensuring that all activities are completed within the stipulated timeframe and budget. This includes planning resources, scheduling work, monitoring progress, and implementing corrective measures when required. Strong supervisory and leadership capabilities are critical, as the individual will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and fostering a productive work environment.
   

  

 In addition to construction oversight, the candidate must ensure strict compliance with quality standards and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) regulations. The role involves implementing and monitoring quality assurance and quality control processes to ensure that all works meet industry standards and client expectations. The Construction Manager must proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with construction activities, ensuring minimal disruption to project progress.
   

  

 Experience in subcontractor management is a crucial requirement for this position. The candidate should have a proven track record of selecting, managing, and coordinating subcontractors to ensure that all work is executed efficiently and in compliance with project specifications. This includes reviewing subcontractor performance, resolving disputes, and ensuring alignment with project objectives.
   

  

 Risk management is another key aspect of the role. The Construction Manager must identify potential project risks at an early stage and develop mitigation strategies to avoid delays or cost overruns. The ability to make informed decisions under pressure and adapt to changing project conditions is essential.
   

  

 The candidate must be self\-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while maintaining a collaborative approach within the project team. Strong problem\-solving skills are required to address technical and operational challenges effectively. Attention to detail, combined with the ability to see the bigger picture, will enable the successful delivery of projects that meet or exceed client expectations.
   

  

 Overall, the Construction Manager – Electrical will have full responsibility for managing and supervising all construction\-related activities, ensuring the successful execution and timely completion of projects in line with contractual commitments. This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging and high\-profile projects, contributing significantly to the development of power and infrastructure sectors in the region.

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Plan, coordinate, and supervise all MEP construction activities from mobilization through project completion.
* Review design drawings, specifications, and shop drawings to ensure compliance with project requirements and identify potential construction issues.
* Coordinate MEP works with civil, structural, architectural, and infrastructure teams to ensure smooth project execution and eliminate interface conflicts.
* Monitor construction progress against approved schedules and implement corrective actions to mitigate delays.
* Review subcontractor work programs, manpower deployment, and resource planning to ensure timely project delivery.
* Manage and supervise MEP subcontractors, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, project specifications, and company standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections to verify workmanship, installation quality, and compliance with approved methods and safety requirements.
* Ensure all MEP works comply with applicable Dubai authority regulations, approval requirements, inspections, and testing procedures.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover activities with consultants, authorities, and clients.
* Review RFIs, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation to support project execution.
* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, highlighting project status, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Identify technical and commercial risks and work proactively with project stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Ensure strict adherence to quality assurance, quality control, health, safety, and environmental requirements.
* Support value engineering initiatives and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality or performance.
* Assist in project closeout activities, including as\-built documentation, O\&M manuals, snagging, and final handover.


 Qualifications
   

  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 8–12 years of MEP construction experience, with at least 5 years managing large\-scale residential, commercial, hospitality, or mixed\-use developments in the UAE.
* Strong knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, electrical, ELV, and building services systems.
* Thorough understanding of Dubai authority requirements, testing and commissioning procedures, and statutory approvals.
* Experience managing MEP subcontractors and coordinating multidisciplinary construction teams.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, Primavera P6, and project management software.
* Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong project planning and execution capabilities.
* Technical expertise in building services engineering.
* Stakeholder and subcontractor coordination.
* Quality\-focused with strong attention to detail.
* Commercial awareness and cost control.
* Risk assessment and mitigation.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

* Monitor the project expenditure to ensure it is aligned with the agreed and approved project budget.
* Provide early warnings of possible variations / additional expenditure requirements.
* Suggest to management mitigation strategies for potential project program delays or cost over\-runs.
* Review interim payment applications and make recommendations for approval and / or deductions.
* Review the consultants and contractors’ quality procedures to ensure works are executed correctly, in accordance with good engineering practice and avoiding abortive works.
* Ensure all project participants adopt best practice HSE protocols.
* Coordinate onsite witness testing and inspections as required.
* Ensure the supervision consultants inspect all aspects of the contracted Works and issue a comprehensive punch / snag list.
* Prepare and coordinate preliminary hand\-over inspections and witness testing.
* Coordinate final hand\-over inspections.
* Coordinate with the Operator / end user training procedures.
* Review and approve final hand\-over inspections.
* Ensure the supervisions reviews for completeness the As\-Built information together with the Operation and Maintenance manuals issued by the contractor.
* Coordinate with the relevant stakeholders in obtaining the necessary NOC’s from utility providers and government authorities.
* Coordinate pre\-opening activities with the Operator.
* Inspect the Works during the Defects Notification Period and make recommendations for any contract adjustments.
* Provide a recommendation for the Final Payment Certificate.



  





**About You:** 



* Minimum 10 years’ experience in the construction industry from either a developer or consultancy background.
* At least 5 years focused on project delivery, preferably within a top tier developer international project management firm with specific experience on luxury hospitality.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related discipline
* Proven experience delivering hospitality led refurbishments or luxury hotel projects
* Experience working within live operational assets is essential
* Budgeting: Commercially aware of construction costs and the impact of the decision\-making process on budgets. Able to manage and control costs and offer direction on cost effective solutions inc. leading value engineering processes.
* Stakeholder Management: Establish and maintain relationships with project stakeholders from operational teams, consultants, contractors, authorities and those with project influence. Proactively engaging to foster effective communication.
* Project Management: Able to implement Project management processes.
* Sustainability: Experience of sustainable construction, renewable technology and construction best practice.
* Programmes: Able to prepare and advise on programme impact relative to the overall project delivery objectives and to mitigate the impact of project delays on the overall schedule.
* Quality Control: Able to manage and advise on quality control procedures on site to achieve an exemplary product.
* Project Reporting: Able to prepare and present reports for the wider organisation to update progress on projects status
* Risk Management: An appreciation of risks and understanding of how to document them, including mitigation plans to ensure projects are delivered within their respective constraints.
* Must be proficient in MS Office suite of tools.



  





**About the Benefits:** 




 At Dubai Holding, we're committed to nurturing the success and well\-being of our colleagues. Join our dynamic and diverse team, and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, career development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We strongly believe in creating an empowered workforce that will help us build a connected city for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing the most pioneering candidates who desire to make a great impact on the future of Dubai.
