data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

**Position Overview**
 Your Role
   

  

 You as a Relationship Manager are the primary point of contact for clients to access the entire suite of wealth management capabilities and solutions offered by Deutsche Bank Wealth Management. This is achieved by working in close partnership with the Investment Manager (IM) in the day\-to\-day planning and servicing for the client.  Your Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Identify, develop and maintain HNW/UHNW relationships.
* Increase wallet share/AuM by undertaking a business development, sales or relationship management approach as appropriate.
* Responsible for the overall Net New Assets creation and revenue generation on the respective books in a scalable and efficient way.
* Balance client relationship, prospect buiding, investment growth, administrative compliance, personal growth and development on a day\-to\-day and longer\-term basis.
* Plan and manage resources (time, budget) to run an optimal business.
* Recommend investment products and services that are suitable for clients based on their objectives, resources, time, horizon, risk profile and preferences.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Client\-oriented, solution\-oriented and able to work in a high paced environment under pressure

* Strong Collaboration skills and excellent communication skills with a positive approach

data.jd_text:
**About the job** 




 Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




 Dubai Holding is seeking to hire a
 **Scrum Master** 
 at its corporate office, reporting to the Director – AI Product Lead. The role holder will act as Scrum Master across multiple AI product squads, each led by a Product Manager, helping teams deliver against defined objectives by removing impediments, improving effectiveness, and ensuring clear visibility of progress, risks, and dependencies. Product priorities and delivery outcomes will remain the accountability of the Product Managers.
 



 The role holder is expected to embed agile best practices across cross\-functional squads, facilitate efficient execution, and maintain a consistent delivery cadence of AI\-enabled agentic digital products. This will require an understanding of how AI\-driven capabilities — including agentic workflows and automation — affect sprint planning, backlog management, and delivery patterns.
 



 These efforts will support the adoption and scaling of a product\-led delivery model across Dubai Holding.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





*Agile Delivery Facilitation* 




 • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies (planning, stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives), ensuring they are efficient and outcome\-focused
 



 • Support squads in defining clear sprint goals and maintaining delivery cadence
 



 • Ensure backlog readiness and alignment with sprint objectives
 



  





*Delivery Flow \& Impediment Resolution* 




 • Identify and remove blockers that impact squad delivery
 



 • Coordinate with stakeholders to resolve cross\-functional issues
 



 • Escalate systemic impediments affecting delivery timelines
 



  





*Delivery Visibility \& Performance Tracking* 




 • Maintain visibility of sprint progress, delivery cadence, and key metrics (e.g. velocity, completion rate)
 



 • Track and communicate risks, dependencies, and delivery challenges
 



 • Support Product Managers and AI Product Lead with accurate delivery insights
 



  





*Cross\-Squad Coordination* 




 • Identify and manage dependencies across squads
 



 • Ensure alignment across engineering, data, and business teams
 



 • Support smooth coordination of cross\-functional delivery activities
 



  





*Continuous Improvement \& Agile Adoption* 




 • Drive team retrospectives and ensure follow\-through of improvement actions
 



 • Promote consistent agile practices and ways of working across squads
 



 • Encourage a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning within squads, providing coaching as needed
 



 • Contribute to scaling agile delivery practices as the product organization grows
 



  





**Who we are looking for:** 



* 5 to 7 years of experience in Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Roles
* Experience facilitating delivery in AI, data, or digital product environments is preferred
* Experience with digital first organizations is preferred (FAANG, digital scale\-ups)
* Coaching and developing cross\-functional squad members and product managers



  





**Education / Professional Certifications:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (IT, Business, Engineering)
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) required
* SAFe or equivalent enterprise agile certification is a plus



  





**Technical Competencies:** 



* Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban)
* Delivery tracking and backlog management tools (e.g. Jira)
* Managing dependencies in multi\-squad environments
* Understanding of product\-led delivery models
* Awareness of AI\-enabled / agentic delivery patterns
* Facilitation and coaching techniques



**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strong facilitation and communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across teams
* Ability to influence and drive alignment without formal authority
* Strong execution focus, ensuring delivery commitments are met
* Structured approach to problem\-solving and continuous improvement



 Adaptability to operate in fast\-paced and evolving environments
 



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




  





**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

 Around 6 to 8 years in account management within an agency environment, with a track record of owning senior client relationships
 



 Experience navigating complex, multi\-stakeholder accounts
 



 Real exposure to strategy work and pitching, and the appetite to do more of both
 



 Someone who brings a point of view, anticipates rather than waits, and is ready to lead
 



  





 How we will support you
 



 Clearly defined Role and Expectations
 



 Support and guidance from best in category business, creative and strategic leadership
 



 Transparent and urgent communication standards
 



 An agency culture that ensures you are set up for the best work of your life \- We think without borders, so that everyone can belong.
 



  





 🚀 We're hiring. Apply now if you're ready to raise the bar.
 



 Include your CV with a clear track record of the accounts and results you've owned.

Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 "At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our
 **Asset Management department** 
 would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Senior Associate** 
 in our office in
 **Dubai** 




 This role supports the ongoing oversight and development of a multi strategy investment platform, covering both third party fund selection and internally managed portfolios and strategies.
 



 The individual will be responsible for monitoring performance, analyzing portfolio positioning, assessing risk, contributing to portfolio construction and allocation decisions, and directly managing or co\-managing internal investment strategies.
 



 The role requires prior portfolio management or direct investment decision making experience, enabling the individual to interpret investment strategies, challenge assumptions, and contribute meaningfully to investment outcomes across the platform.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Investment Oversight and Performance Analysis** 



* Conduct detailed performance analysis and attribution across all funds on the platform shelf
* Assess consistency of returns relative to benchmarks and peers across equity, fixed income, multi asset, and alternative strategies
* Identify performance drivers and sources of risk at the fund and portfolio level
* Monitor ongoing alignment between fund positioning and stated mandates across the feeder fund universe



  





**Portfolio Management and Internal Strategies** 



* Support portfolio construction and strategic asset allocation decisions across the platform
* Contribute to tactical allocation discussions informed by macroeconomic and market developments
* Evaluate trade offs across asset classes, geographies, and strategies within the multi asset framework
* Manage or co manage internal portfolios and strategies, including shadow portfolios and proprietary funds
* Provide input into positioning for the target risk advisory models underpinning the platform
* Execute rebalancing and allocation changes as directed by the Head of Asset Management



  





**Risk and Style Monitoring** 



* Monitor volatility, drawdown, and factor exposures across the fund shelf and internal portfolios
* Identify style drift, unintended concentration risk, and deviations from stated mandates
* Assess portfolio balance and risk contribution at the strategy and aggregate level
* Provide forward looking risk insights to support allocation and oversight decisions



  





**Portfolio and Holdings Analysis** 



* Analyse holdings level data and allocation shifts across funds and internal portfolios
* Evaluate alignment between portfolio positioning and stated investment strategy over time
* Track changes in sector, geographic, and factor exposures across market cycles
* Contribute to due diligence by grounding analysis in security selection and bottom up positioning



  





**Manager Oversight and Engagement** 



* Engage with third party fund managers as a credible and informed investment counterpart
* Challenge portfolio positioning, strategy consistency, and investment decision making in manager interactions
* Prepare detailed questions and investment insights ahead of manager meetings and due diligence calls
* Assess quality and consistency of manager decision making over time and across market environments



  





**Platform Level Investment Intelligence** 



* Maintain and develop internal dashboards covering performance, risk, positioning, and cost analysis
* Evaluate share class efficiency, fee structures, and total cost of ownership across the fund shelf
* Support fund selection and comparative analysis across managers for new fund onboarding
* Contribute to the development of investment views, house positioning, and thematic research



  





**Governance, Reporting, and Regulatory Alignment** 



* Prepare investment committee materials, portfolio reviews, and board level reporting
* Maintain documentation and reporting aligned with SCA regulatory requirements and governance standards
* Support prospectus preparation, cell supplement reviews, and regulatory submissions where applicable
* Ensure all investment activity is documented in line with the governance framework



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




**Technical Skills** 



* Deep understanding of strategic and tactical asset allocation, portfolio construction, and risk budgeting
* Strong capability in performance attribution, factor analysis, and risk decomposition
* Ability to interpret holdings level data, exposure analysis, and portfolio analytics
* Proficiency in Bloomberg and similar investment platforms
* Advanced Excel required for financial modelling, performance tracking, and scenario analysis
* Python, SQL, or similar data tools preferred for automation and analytics



  





**Competencies** 



* Strong investment judgment and independent thinking with the ability to form and defend views
* Ability to engage with and challenge portfolio managers with credibility and substance
* Clear and structured articulation of investment views in both written and verbal form
* High ownership, accountability, and comfort operating in a lean, fast moving team
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex investment concepts into
 **accessible language**








**Experience Requirements** 



* 5 to 8 years of experience in asset management, institutional investing, or portfolio management
* Prior experience in portfolio management, co\-management, or direct investment decision making is essential
* Demonstrable experience across multi asset portfolios, fund selection platforms, or fund of funds structures
* Familiarity with UCITS, SICAV, or similar regulated fund structures is highly preferred
* Experience working with global custodians, fund administrators, and transfer agents is an advantage
* CFA Level III candidate preferred
* Relevant graduate degree in finance, economics, or a related discipline is an advantage



  





  





**Perks** 




 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
Independent Food Company is home to some of the region's most recognised hospitality concepts, including SALT, Somewhere, Parker's, Shalwa, Somewhere, and Public. We are a fast\-growing organisation with an expanding portfolio of concepts, an active acquisition strategy, and ambitious plans for growth across new and existing markets. As we scale, the quality of our people remains central to everything we build. That is where you come in.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Director of Real Estate is responsible for managing and expanding the organization’s retail property portfolio, including site selection, lease negotiations, budget analysis, and store openings across the UAE and franchisees. This role requires strategic leadership to develop and implement real estate strategies aligned with the company’s vision, while building strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensuring compliance with industry standards. The Director will lead a team and work closely with operations, project managers, and developers to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and achieve sustainable expansion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Planning and Market Analysis:** 




 • Conduct in\-depth market and competitive analysis to develop independent expansion plans, either in house or outsourced.
 



 • Prepare and submit annual business plans to the board, ensuring equal growth opportunities for all brands.
 



 • Create and implement real estate strategies tailored to each brand’s demographics, pricing, and product range.
 



 • Present brand market potential and expansion capacity for the next 3 years.
 



 • Conduct Real Estate Market Mapping and Sales Forecasting.
 



 • Develop and present detailed feasibility studies, including financial projections and market analysis, prior to obtaining site approvals
 



  





**Existing Portfolio Management, Renewals, and Crisis Resolution** 




 • Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Tracking: Proactively manage and monitor the performance of the existing real estate portfolio, conducting monthly reviews of asset performance, rent\-to\-sales ratios, and location viability.
 



 • Lease Renewals \& Restructuring: Oversee the end\-to\-end lease renewal pipeline, evaluating historical store performance to determine whether to renew, renegotiate terms, relocate, or exit properties.
 



 • Crisis Management \& Landlord Relations: Act as the primary point of escalation and resolution for property crises (e.g., operational disruptions, landlord\-tenant disputes, mall maintenance issues affecting sales, or unexpected economic downturns). Lead rent\-reduction or lease\-restructuring negotiations during operational crises to safeguard company margins.
 



  





**Site Selection and Management** 




 • Aggressive Location Scouting: Lead hands\-on, ground\-level field scouting and site mapping to uncover premium, off\-market, or high\-potential spaces (malls, high\-streets, cloud kitchens, and standalone spots) tailored to specific brand concepts.
 



 • Conduct comprehensive site assessments, traffic counts, visibility analyses, and accessibility mapping to guarantee optimum footfall and brand exposure.
 



 • Investigate, evaluate, and identify potential sites, markets, towns, and competition for new store locations.
 



 • Manage schedules for projects and oversee processes to obtain permits and approvals.
 



 • Prepare detailed project estimates and reports for management review.
 



  





**F\&B Project Development** 




 • Oversee the development of F\&B projects, including feasibility studies, design monitoring, and financial analyses.
 



 • Develop and implement strategies to expand and improve F\&B offerings in retail locations, aligning with company goals and market trends.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align F\&B goals with overall business objectives.
 



 • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
 



 • Provide insights and guidance on food and beverage (F\&B) operations, including labor optimization, supply chain logistics, and customer service standards, to ensure successful project execution.
 



 • Ensure properties and real estate strategies aligned with delivering exceptional guest experiences, prioritizing innovation, quality, and service excellence
 



  





**Team Development and Risk Management** 




 • Recruit, manage, and develop a high\-performing team, including managers and supervisors, to build a reliable and effective department for market mapping and research.
 



 • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards in all property dealings. • Identify and mitigate risks, including regulatory and financial risks, through effective risk management strategies.
 



 • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, aligned with the company’s core value
 



  





**Contractual \& Commercial Lease Terms Governance** 




 • Legal \& Commercial De\-risking: Direct the drafting, review, and structuring of all legal lease agreements, ensuring all commercial and operational terms protect the company's long\-term interests.
 



 • Clause Enforcement: Secure favorable legal clauses, including but not limited to: Exclusivity/Non compete protections within specific developments, clear termination and break\-clauses, realistic force majeure terms, and capped annual rent escalations.
 



  





**Landlord Negotiations \& Deal Structuring** 




 • Deal Sourcing \& Commercial Pitches: Lead high\-stakes commercial negotiations with major developers (e.g., Emaar, Nakheel, Majid Al Futtaim, Merex) and private landlords to secure highly competitive rates and preferential positioning.
 



 • Financial Terms Optimization: Strategically negotiate base rents, turnover rent percentages, rent\-free periods (fit\-out periods), key money, and landlord fit\-out contributions to maximize early\-stage ROI and reduce capital expenditure.
 



  





**Business Development and Relationship Management** 




 • Create, pitch, and build new leads with developers, investors, and local authorities.
 



 • Develop business and market plans for all brands acquired or franchised by the company.
 



 • Address stakeholder concerns and collaborate on approvals and permits.
 



 • Stay updated on industry trends, demographic shifts, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and recommend strategies for sustainable growth.
 



 • Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity by understanding local customs, preferences, and business practices in the Middle East, ensuring alignment with regional expectations
 



  





**Other Duties:** 




 Perform other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by management from time to time.

data.jd_text:
**Job Requisition ID:** 
 178944
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
* The Head of Data Science \& Asset Risk holds a pivotal role within Al\-Futtaim's financial services division, responsible for overseeing analytics, forecasting, and risk intelligence. The key purpose is to optimize the company’s automotive and financial services portfolio using data\-driven insights. This role combines financial control, risk management, and analytics leadership to support executive and board\-level decision\-making. Key responsibilities include maintaining market indices and price curves, defining asset risk frameworks, providing risk\-driven inputs to capital planning, and acting as the technical authority on asset valuation and risk. Success is measured by the ability to turn data and AI into explainable, regulator\-ready financial outcomes and to influence strategic decisions that impact P\&L, balance sheet, and return on assets.The position operates at the intersection of CFO\-level financial control, CRO\-level risk management and CDO\-level analytics leadership, supporting executive and Board decision\-making across the group.


**What You Will Do:**
* Own end\-to\-end analytics, forecasting, and risk intelligence for the automotive and financial services portfolio.
* Turn data, AI, and market intelligence into financial outcomes that drive pricing, leasing, provisioning, capital allocation, and portfolio strategy.
* Maintain authoritative market indices, price curves, and forward\-looking scenarios for all brands, powertrains, and segments.
* Define and enforce the Asset Risk Framework covering market risk, EV transition risk, concentration risk, and volatility.
* Provide risk\-driven inputs to IFRS9, provisions, ECL, and capital planning.
* Ensure all models are auditable, explainable, and regulator\-ready.
* Act as the single source of truth for portfolio value, forward price risk, stress scenarios, and financial impact of market movements.
* Chair the Residual Value \& Risk Committees and translate complex analytics into clear financial actions for CFO, CRO, and Executive Management.
* Influence vehicle pricing and lease structures, portfolio profitability and risk appetite, provisioning and capital allocation, OEM negotiations, and product launches.
* Own the AI\-driven asset intelligence platform including data pipelines, forecasting, valuation, and risk models.
* Lead a senior team of Data Scientists and Analytics specialists.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* Advanced expertise in data science and statistical analysis.
* Proficient in risk management and financial modelling.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills for executive\-level reporting and committee participation.


**What Qualifies You For The Role:**
* 10\+ years of experience in statistics, data science, risk management, pricing, forecasting, or financial modelling.
* Experience in automotive, asset finance, banking, insurance, or management of large portfolios.
* Demonstrated ownership of models crucial to P\&L impact.
* Strong background in IFRS9, ECL, stress testing, or portfolio risk management.
* Comfortable operating at CFO, CRO, and board level interactions.


**About Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
 The real estate development and operations arm of Al\-Futtaim, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high\-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega\-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
   

  

 Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
   

  

 AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Malls**
 Al\-Futtaim Malls provides development and asset management expertise, specializing in building retail\-led super regional malls in prime locations across MENA and beyond. With a proven track record of creating both sustainable revenue growth and value enhancement for tenants, Al\-Futtaim Malls delivers exceptional experiences and exciting shopping environments for customers.
   

  

 Part of the Al\-Futtaim Group, Al\-Futtaim Malls leadership team brings more than 30 years of experience and a deep understanding and knowledge of the retail sector, both from a shopper’s point of view but as curators of space or landlords to other brands. The company has a directly managed portfolio including over 9 million sqft of retail space across four malls in the MENA region and two under development. Malls under the Al\-Futtaim Malls portfolio include Dubai Festival City Mall and Festival Plaza in the UAE, Cairo Festival City Mall in Egypt, Doha Festival City in Qatar and Zenata Mall, Morocco.
   

  

 Leveraging on the expertise of its parent company, Al\-Futtaim Malls established PLEX Management Services offering a full array of services including asset management and development, leasing, and brand experience expertise to shopping mall landlords and retail organizations globally. Implementing global best practice and deploying Al\-Futtaim Mall’s deep understanding of mall management and retail dynamics, PLEX promises to deliver continuous growth and long\-term value for its partners.
   

  

 For more information on Al\-Futtaim Malls, please visit https://www.al\-futtaimmalls.com/
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies**
 Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies offers customers complete engineering and systems integration solutions.
   

  

 The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
   

  

 The Technologies division provides complete business solutions to large, medium and small customers that include, contact centre solutions, business applications, business intelligence, data management, advanced analytics amongst others. The IT infrastructure portfolio comprises IP telephony, ELV systems, networking solutions, professional audio\-visual solutions and managed services.
   

  

 These solutions are further complemented by services that include project management, installation, testing, commissioning and after\-sales maintenance contracts.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
* The Director of Transition Finance and Advisory (TFA) (Market) role is responsible for acting as the primary sustainable finance and transition advisory point of contact for bankers and clients in the market. The role translates global frameworks, thematic insights and bank capabilities into credible client positioning and executable financing pathways. The role focuses on Origination, Client Engagement and Content Creation with a focus on driving commercial impact.
* This role will work in close partnership with Coverage and Risk teams, brings sector insight, disciplined judgement, and cross‑border connectivity to deliver sustainable growth across the Transition Finance and Advisory portfolio.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Support origination and execution of Sustainable and Transition Finance transactions**
**Sustainable Finance** 
 (SF)
 **Products’ origination** 
 (including RFPs), with a focus on:
   

  

* Increasing awareness of SF offerings and benefits among underpenetrated clients (solution replicability).
* Winning new businesses where ESG can differentiate the bank (e.g. SF coordinator role) vs. competing primarily on balance sheet size and pricing, such as ESG structured notes).
* Identifying client opportunities for distribution of the bank’s sustainable finance assets.
* SF product execution / structuring, where agreed with Products and the bank is SF coordinator. Focus on expansion of our sustainability\-linked framework to consider additional / novel KPIs.
* Work with targeted (less sophisticated) clients on SF / Transition frameworks when clear monetisation opportunities (first SLL deal, capturing conventional client SoW)
* Work with the Global Transition Technologies teams to originate Energy Transition transactions across our markets. Three areas of focus:
* Capital partnerships: preferred origination partner to large energy\-transition funds and sovereign platforms (through partnerships)
* Platform story: package Energy Transition as a repeatable consolidation as platform creation is becoming more common in this next phase of fragmented energy transition market consolidation (becoming PP)
* Partner to governments on capital mobilization (incl. Sponsors): decarbonization, energy, and minerals security with increased state co\-funding and de\-risking.


**Contribute to content\-led client engagements with clear monetisation opportunities**
* Leverage content and expertise to contribute to high‑quality client engagements that lead to tangible revenue outcomes, including direct contribution to transition and sustainable finance transactions, origination support, and expansion of client wallet share.


**Thought leadership and proprietary content development**
* Develop understanding of market specific SF developments (incl. emerging E\&S risk themes and ‘hot spots’, SF market trends and product uptakes), and how this will impact our clients and client insights.
* Develop sector\-specific content:
* Covering ESG thematic / trends / market dynamics, peer benchmarking, product benchmarking / recent transactions / case studies
* Producing analysis and content around ESG risks and controversies impacting resilience, and investor confidence
* Incorporating Transition tech (e.g. SAF) and Capital Structure considerations
* Leveraging relevant thematic from CSO Innovation Hubs (e.g. Carbon, Nature)


 Support brand building and profiling: Participate in relevant industry initiatives to gather relevant market intelligence, demonstrate thought leadership, and maintain client connectivity.
   

  

 Strengthen governance, risk discipline, and role clarity: Act as first line accountable leader for conduct, reputational, and advisory risks within the mandate. Ensure teams operate within defined frameworks, avoid greenwashing risk, and maintain clear boundaries with Coverage, Products, and regulatory functions.
   

  

 Adhere to values \& conduct expectations (non\-negotiable): By role\-modelling ethical conduct, risk discipline, client suitability, inclusion, and enterprise first leadership.
   

  

**Measure of Success**
* Direct contribution to SF \& TF transactions: the team will work towards a target direct dollar contribution to SF / TF transactions.
* Client income contribution: the team will work towards a dollar client income contribution amount tagged to an agreed list of clients that have been identified as having a strong opportunity for increased share of wallet.
* High\-quality client engagements: the team will work towards a specified number of target client engagements to be completed within an agreed time period. These client engagements will be focused on where there is a real opportunity to drive commercial impact.
* Marketing activities: the team will work towards producing an agreed amount of thought leadership pieces of content and participation in key industry forums.


**Skills And Experience**
* Sustainable and Transition Finance
* Climate Transition and Decarbonization
* Financing and Structured Solutions
* Business Development
* Corporate Finance
* Financial Analysis
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Regulatory Environment – Financial Services


**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**
* Experience in sustainable finance, ESG or transition advisory across sectors and markets, with the ability to translate policy, transition and ESG developments into financially and credit\-relevant insights.
* Track record of developing scalable sector narratives, analytical insights or flagship content, and of shaping frameworks or methodologies used across regions.
* Experience supporting complex or novel sustainable or transition finance situations, influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Risk, Credit, CSO and Coverage in matrixed environments


**Certifications / Qualifications**
* Advanced knowledge of sustainable and transition finance concepts, market standards and emerging practices, gained through professional experience or formal training.


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

WW\+P is a world\-leading architecture, urban design, and planning practice with more than 400 architects, urban designers, and planners across 12 studios worldwide, including offices in London and Manchester. Founded in 1985, the practice integrates planning, urban design, landscape architecture, and architecture to deliver projects that combine visionary regenerative design thinking with technical excellence. Our work spans scales and disciplines to create better cities, smarter infrastructure, and more inclusive communities.
   

  





 WW\+P is also a member of the 10N Collective, a group of leading urbanism, architecture, and design practices brought together by Egis. In 2026, SvN Architects and Planners merged with WW\+P, bringing together more than 80 years of combined expertise in transformative urban design and planning.

* Lead all stages of the investment process, including opportunity assessment, financial analysis, valuation, structuring, due diligence, negotiations, and execution

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a leading sovereign wealth investor to hire a Senior Associate into its Public Markets team. This is a strategic asset allocator seat: the core of the role is selecting, appointing and overseeing best\-in\-class external fund managers across global public markets, rather than managing positions actively on a day\-to\-day basis.
 



  





 The mandate is built around long\-term, strategic allocation of capital through external managers. You will help decide which managers earn the institution's capital, why, and at what size, then monitor that conviction over time. If you enjoy manager due diligence, allocation decisions and patient, research\-led oversight more than running a trading book, this will suit you.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 Reporting to the Head of Public Markets, you will support the full external manager lifecycle across equities, fixed income, liquid alternatives and multi\-asset strategies.
 



  





**What you will focus on:** 




  




* Mapping the investable external manager universe across asset classes, styles and geographies using databases, consultant networks, conferences and industry contacts.
* Screening strategies on performance, risk, factor exposures, drawdowns, liquidity, capacity and fees to shortlist managers for deeper due diligence.
* Leading qualitative and quantitative due diligence, including meetings with portfolio managers, analysts and risk officers, to assess philosophy, process, portfolio construction, alpha drivers and team stability.
* Applying analytics to distinguish genuinely active, skilled managers from market beta, and testing whether fees and compensation are justified.
* Coordinating operational and risk due diligence with risk, legal and compliance teams.
* Preparing manager selection reports and investment memos, and presenting hire / retain / redeem recommendations to investment committees.
* Negotiating mandate terms, fees, performance structures, liquidity terms and side letters to align manager incentives with the institution's objectives.
* Monitoring appointed managers against benchmarks and peers, maintaining conviction ratings, and supporting rebalancing and allocation sizing decisions.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




  




* 5–7 years in public markets investing, with a clear emphasis on external manager selection, including Hedge Funds, oversight and monitoring (from a pension fund, consultant, family office, SWF or asset manager).
* Demonstrable hedge fund and liquid alternatives manager selection experience is important for this mandate.
* A genuine orientation toward long\-term, strategic allocation through external funds rather than active, day\-to\-day position management.
* Strong manager research depth: the ability to judge whether a manager's past results are repeatable.
* Solid quantitative evaluation skills across performance, factor/style and risk analysis.
* Structured decision\-making, sound risk awareness and the judgement to make clear hire/retain/terminate calls.
* Confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to defend recommendations to investment committees.
* CFA or an advanced degree in finance, economics or a related field.
* High integrity, a fiduciary mindset and an entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach.



  





**What is on offer:** 




  





 A high\-visibility seat with one of the region's most respected institutional investors, direct exposure to senior decision\-makers and global external managers, and a long\-term, conviction\-led approach to public markets investing, based in Dubai.

**Job Description**
 The Senior Project Controls Manager will provide strategic leadership and oversight of all project controls functions for a major high\-rise development in Riyadh. The role will be responsible for establishing and managing project controls governance, including planning, scheduling, cost management, risk management, change control, reporting, and performance monitoring across all project phases.
   

  

 Acting as a key member of the PMC leadership team, the Senior Project Controls Manager will ensure robust controls are implemented from the post\-concept design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover, enabling informed decision\-making and successful project delivery in line with client objectives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Project Controls Leadership**
 Lead and manage all project controls activities across the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Develop and implement the Project Controls Management Plan, procedures, and governance framework.
   

  

 Provide strategic advice to the Project Director and Client on project performance, risks, and opportunities.
   

  

 Lead and mentor planning, cost control, reporting, and risk management teams.
   

  

**Planning \& Scheduling**
 Establish and maintain the integrated project master programme covering design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
   

  

 Review and approve contractors’ and consultants’ schedules, methodologies, and recovery plans.
   

  

 Conduct critical path analysis and schedule risk assessments.
   

  

 Monitor project progress against approved baselines and recommend corrective actions.
   

  

 Ensure timely achievement of key project milestones and deliverables.
   

  

**Cost Management \& Commercial Oversight**
 Lead project cost control, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management.
   

  

 Establish cost reporting systems and performance measurement indicators.
   

  

 Monitor commitments, expenditures, change requests, and forecasted project costs.
   

  

 Support commercial and contract management teams regarding valuation, variations, and claims.
   

  

 Advise project leadership on financial performance and potential cost risks.
   

  

**Risk \& Change Management**
 Establish and maintain project risk management processes and risk registers.
   

  

 Facilitate periodic risk workshops and mitigation planning sessions.
   

  

 Lead schedule and cost impact assessments for changes and variations.
   

  

 Ensure proper governance and approvals for all change control activities.
   

  

**Reporting \& Performance Management**
 Develop executive dashboards, KPIs, and performance reporting frameworks.
   

  

 Present project performance reports to senior stakeholders and the Client.
   

  

 Track project health indicators and provide early warning notices on emerging issues.
   

  

 Utilize Earned Value Management (EVM) and performance analytics to monitor project delivery.
   

  

**Claims \& Dispute Avoidance**
 Provide project controls input into claims evaluation and extension\-of\-time assessments.
   

  

 Review contractor claims, delay analyses, and entitlement submissions.
   

  

 Support contract administration and dispute resolution activities.
   

  

 Ensure robust project records and documentation are maintained.
   

  

**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
 Act as the primary project controls interface with the Client, designers, contractors, and key stakeholders.
   

  

 Participate in executive steering committee and project review meetings.
   

  

 Build strong relationships with project stakeholders to facilitate successful project delivery.
   

  

 Provide strategic recommendations and presentations to senior management.
   

  

**Digital Project Controls**
 Drive the implementation of project controls technologies and digital reporting tools.
   

  

 Lead the utilization of Primavera P6, Power BI, cost management systems, and project dashboards.

 The Senior Project Controls Manager – Utility Compounds is responsible for establishing and leading all project controls functions (planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change, and reporting) across one or more utility compounds and associated infrastructure works. This role provides strategic oversight and assurance that scope, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved, while maintaining robust governance, transparent reporting, and proactive risk management for complex, multi‑contract utility developments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Controls Leadership**
* Lead the project controls strategy and implementation for utility compound programs.
* Develop and maintain integrated project controls plans, aligning schedule, cost, risk, change, and reporting processes with corporate and client requirements.

* Ensure consistency and standardization of project controls procedures across all contracts and work packages.


**Planning \& Scheduling**
* Establish, review, and approve baseline schedules in collaboration with planning engineers and project leads.
* Integrate multiple contractor and internal schedules into a single program\-level master schedule.
* Monitor schedule performance, analyze critical paths, float, and interfaces between utility compounds and wider network works.
* Lead schedule risk analysis and scenario planning to assess and mitigate potential delays.
* Review contractors’ recovery plans and assess their viability.


**Cost Management \& Forecasting**
* Develop and manage project budgets, cash flow forecasts, and cost control frameworks for utility compounds.
* Oversee cost tracking, commitment control, and monthly cost/value reconciliations.
* Lead cost forecasting and estimate\-at\-completion reviews, ensuring alignment with schedule and risk.
* Identify cost variances, trends, and opportunities for savings; recommend corrective and optimizing measures.


**Change \& Risk Management**
* Set up and manage robust change control processes, including impact assessments on scope, time, cost, and risk.
* Chair or support change control boards, ensuring timely review, approval, and documentation of changes.
* Establish and maintain project risk registers, facilitating risk identification, qualitative/quantitative assessment, and mitigation planning.
* Coordinate schedule and cost risk analyses and integrate results into forecasts and management reporting.


**Performance Measurement \& Reporting**
* Implement earned value management or equivalent performance measurement techniques.
* Define and monitor KPIs for schedule adherence, cost performance, productivity, and change/risk effectiveness.
* Produce clear, concise monthly and ad‑hoc project controls reports for senior management, clients, and stakeholders.
* Provide early warning on emerging issues and propose data‑driven mitigation and recovery strategies.


**Data, Systems \& Governance**
* Oversee configuration and use of project controls tools (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project, cost management and reporting systems).
* Ensure data integrity, version control, and alignment between planning, cost, and reporting systems.
* Develop and maintain project controls procedures, templates, and standards tailored to utility compound delivery.
* Support internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with company governance and client requirements.


**Stakeholder \& Interface Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for project controls matters with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal leadership.
* Coordinate interfaces between utility compounds and related packages (transmission/distribution, MEP systems, building works, enabling works).
* Present project status, trends, and recommendations in steering committees, progress meetings, and executive reviews.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of planners, cost engineers, risk analysts, and reporting specialists.
* Allocate resources effectively across projects and phases, ensuring adequate coverage for critical milestones.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the project controls function.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 15 years experience in project controls with at least 5 – 10 years on major construction or infrastructure projects, with significant exposure to utilities or industrial compounds.
* Demonstrated experience leading project controls on complex, multi‑contract programs from initiation through closeout.
* Strong understanding of planning, cost control, risk management, change control, and EVM principles.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, or Business.
* Professional certification such as , , , , or equivalent.
* Experience in power / utilities (substations, utility hubs, process plants, or similar compound\-type developments).
* Experience with standard forms of contract (FIDIC) and their implications for schedule and cost management.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Advanced proficiency in project planning software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project) and cost management tools.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and derive actionable insights.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to convey complex project controls information to non‑specialists.
* Proven leadership, team management, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* High level of commercial awareness and understanding of how project controls influence contractual and commercial outcomes.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a highly capable PMO Manager to lead the project management office for a real estate developer in Riyadh.
   

  

 The PMO Manager will oversee the full development delivery cycle: feasibility support, design management, consultant and contractor coordination, cost and schedule control, procurement tracking, risk management, project reporting, handover, and close\-out.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and manage PMO governance, reporting standards, project controls, templates, and approval workflows across the development portfolio
* Monitor projects from design stage through construction, handover, and final close\-out on behalf of the developer
* Prepare executive dashboards and weekly/monthly reports covering project progress, cost, cash flow, risks, design status, procurement, variations, sales readiness, and key decisions required
* Verify actual site progress through regular site inspections and independent validation, rather than relying solely on contractor reports
* Control approved budgets, BOQs, commitments, variations, forecasts, and cost\-to\-complete for each project
* Track master schedules, identify delays early, assess recovery plans, and escalate critical risks to management
* Lead coordination between development, design, finance, procurement, sales, legal, consultants, contractors, and government\-related stakeholders
* Review design deliverables, consultant outputs, BOQs, specifications, tender packages, and construction documentation for completeness before execution
* Monitor consultant and contractor performance against their contractual scope, deliverables, milestones, quality requirements, and approved budgets
* Maintain project risk registers, issue logs, decision trackers, action plans, and mitigation measures
* Support tender evaluations, consultant and contractor appointments, variation reviews, claims assessments, and project close\-out
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with approved product positioning, financial objectives, delivery timelines, and quality standards
* Identify operational gaps and implement practical improvements to strengthen accountability, reporting quality, and delivery performance


**Requirements**
**Mandatory Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline
* Minimum 8 years of total experience in real estate development, project management, project controls, or construction delivery
* Minimum 3 years of direct experience working for a real estate developer / owner / master developer is mandatory
* Demonstrated experience managing residential, mixed\-use, commercial, or hospitality development projects from the developer side
* Proven experience in managing consultants, contractors, design coordination, budgets, BOQs, procurement, variations, project schedules, and handover
* Strong understanding of the full real estate development lifecycle, not only construction execution
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting/dashboard tools
* Strong commercial awareness, including budget monitoring, cash\-flow tracking, cost forecasting, and variation control
* Experience establishing or working within PMO governance frameworks, including project controls, reporting standards, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, and stage\-gate processes
* Experience in project scheduling, critical\-path analysis, recovery planning, progress measurement, and executive reporting
* Experience with tender evaluation, procurement planning, variation assessment, and contractor performance monitoring
* Business\-fluent English
* Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia
* Based in Riyadh or willing to relocate
* Able to conduct regular site visits across active development and construction projects in Riyadh
* Able to work in both office and construction\-site environments
* Able to attend project meetings, inspections, and site walks as required
* Proficient in using a laptop and standard Microsoft Office tools for day\-to\-day work
* Able to work effectively with digital project documentation, drawings, BOQs, schedules, and cloud\-based collaboration platforms


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, PMI\-SP, PMI\-RMP, RICS, Primavera, or equivalent certification
* Experience with project management systems, ERP platforms, or real estate development software
* Experience managing multiple projects or a development portfolio simultaneously
* Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration, preferred for engineering\-degree holders
* Availability to join within 30 to 60 days is a plus


**What We Are Looking For**
* A developer\-side PMO professional who understands the owner's commercial, technical, and delivery priorities
* Someone who can challenge consultants and contractors constructively and protect the developer's interests
* A hands\-on manager with strong site awareness, disciplined reporting, and the ability to identify issues before they become delays or cost overruns
* A leader who can create accountability across internal teams and external stakeholders


**Benefits**
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage
* Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations
* Paid annual leave and public holidays
* Professional development and training opportunities

 Key Skills/Experience Required

data.jd_text:
Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you ready to shape the learning architecture of our digitally native airline and its workforce?
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary and commercially astute Director of Talent Development to lead our enterprise\-wide Learning \& Development strategy thereby building a future ready, safety centered and high\-performing organisation.
   

  

 Yours is a role responsible for building a future\-ready workforce that strengthens safety, performance, and long\-term growth. You are expected to oversee high\-impact learning delivery using blended, digital, simulation\-based, and experiential methods tailored to aviation.
   

  

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.
   

  

 Importantly, your remit includes integrating leadership development, safety/compliance learning, operational training, and digital capability building into a unified enterprise framework. Further, you will design and implement a fully integrated airline learning ecosystem spanning safety, regulatory, operational, leadership, and digital capabilities.
   

  

 Central to your success in this role is the ability to own and manage the Talent Development budget, ensuring strategic ROI. Moreover, you will t rack and report KPIs including bench strength, capability readiness, and program effectiveness.
   

  

 You will also ensure regulatory alignment with key aviation bodies including the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), integrating compliance requirements into enterprise learning frameworks and operational governance.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building future\-ready leaders, strengthening safety culture, and shaping capability at scale, we invite you to lead the next chapter of our talent journey.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 10 years of sound leadership experience within an L\&D or Talent Development capacity interpreting strategy and policy in order to set and deliver objectives within the medium to long term.
   

  

 We’d love to hear from you even more if you are a bilingual Saudi national with proven leadership experience.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.
